archive.description: Securely archive incoming documents from the ERP integrator by UUID, validate UBL lines and prepare them for goods receipt.

import.title: Archive Incoming Document
import.description: Query the integrator using the universal document number. Automatic mode tries e-Invoice first and then e-Archive.
import.noConnection: There is no active eLogo connection with credentials for this branch. Define a connection first.
import.includePdfDescription: UBL is always retrieved; when available, the human-readable PDF is stored in private file storage.
import.securityNote: Session credentials are used only by the server. Passwords are never returned to the client; UBL and PDF files are not stored as Base64 in the database.

kind.automaticDescription: Queries e-Invoice first, then e-Archive if not found.

receipt.title: Goods receipt linking is intentionally controlled
receipt.nextStep: An invoice never creates inventory by itself. A task is created from matched lines; the existing receipt engine posts inventory only after location, lot, serial and physical quantity validation.

receiptDialog.title: Create Goods Receipt Task
receiptDialog.description: Convert selected lines of invoice {{invoiceNo}} into a physical goods receipt task.
receiptDialog.noDespatchReference: The UBL has no despatch reference. Enter the number from the physical document.

lines.title: Invoice Lines to Transfer
lines.trackingNotice: The UBL invoice is the source for stock, quantity and price; lot/serial/expiry are physical receipt evidence. These values are never invented during invoice import and are captured by barcode according to the stock tracking policy while executing the assigned task.

validation.waybill: A normal despatch number must contain exactly 15 digits.
validation.eWaybill: The e-dispatch/GIB number must contain exactly 15 alphanumeric characters.
